query:
SELECT EXISTS (
                 SELECT 1
                 FROM job_item ji
                 JOIN mapping m ON m.org_id = ji.org_id AND m.id = ji.mapping_id
                 JOIN product_file pf
                   ON pf.org_id = m.org_id AND pf.product_id = m.product_id
                 WHERE ji.org_id = $1 AND ji.id = $2
                   AND pf.role = 'payload'
                   AND pf.deleted_at IS NULL
                   AND pf.hash IS NULL
               ) AS "sourced!"
